en.headline: Two people in their 70s found unconscious after charcoal burning at Tuen Mun estate
en.dek: Police said a man and a woman were taken to Tuen Mun Hospital after being discovered unresponsive in a flat at Shan King Estate around 2.30pm on Sunday.
body: Police received a report at about 2.30pm on Sunday that a man and a woman were unresponsive inside a unit at King Wing House, Shan King Estate in Tuen Mun.

Emergency crews found both individuals, understood to be in their 70s, unconscious beside a tray of burnt charcoal. They were taken by ambulance to Tuen Mun Hospital. Officers are investigating the circumstances.
Anyone in emotional distress can call the Samaritans Hong Kong 24-hour hotline on 2896 0000 or the Hospital Authority mental health hotline on 2466 7350.

zh.headline: 屯門山景邨一對約70歲男女燒炭昏迷 送院搶救
zh.dek: 警方指今午約2時30分接報，景榮樓單位內一男一女昏迷，身旁有燒過的炭，已送屯門醫院。
body: 警方今日下午約2時30分接報，指屯門山景邨景榮樓一單位內一男一女失去反應。
救援人員到場發現兩人昏迷，年齡約70多歲，身旁有一盤已燒過的炭。兩人被送往屯門醫院，警方正調查事發經過。
如有情緒困擾，可致電撒瑪利亞防止自殺會24小時熱線2896 0000或醫管局精神健康專線2466 7350。
